message: 覚醒

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Impossible! Impossible, impossible!」
Parrying every single one of the Female Demon's attacks, I closed the distance.
Her face, twisted in terror, appeared right before my eyes.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「O all-encompassing power. Become a shield harder than metal!」
A seemingly useless shield of magic materialized in front of the Female Demon.
I swung my weapon.
It was like cutting through butter with a heated knife.
The shield flared with light and tore apart the instant it was shattered.
And then my blade entered the Female Demon's right shoulder and exited out her left side.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaaaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. It's okay now.」
Still sitting on the ground, Azel looked up at me.

name: Azel
message: 「......I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have anything to apologize for.」

name: Azel
message: 「But, but! I... I!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's go home. Can you stand?」
I held out my hand. Azel timidly reached out to take it.
Her feverish hand was slick with sweat.
Perhaps I misjudged how hard I pulled her up, because as Azel stood, she stumbled and ended up clinging to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. Did I pull too hard?」
Azel wrapped her arms around my back. She stroked my back and shoulders as if confirming I was really there.
I caught the scent of sweat. She was trembling.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel!? What's wrong!? You're sweating so much, and you have a fever too.」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn...... For someone like me...... Going through something like that for someone like me...... I'm sorry, I'm sorry.」
Without thinking, I hugged her back,

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. As long as you're safe, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「But, but, but! Because of me, you almost died, Synn...... Even though it's my fault...... Even though it's all my fault!」
Looking up at me from so close I could feel her breath, her eyes were glistening with tears.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm totally fine. If it's for you, Azel-I mean, well, um, I--」

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「I didn't... never consider that it might turn out like this...」

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Even so... you... took on pointless suffering, didn't you...」
No, she wasn't looking at me. She was looking at Azel.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Even though the ending is already decided... Even though you... understood that... better than anyone... How strange...」
For some reason, her voice carried a tinge of pity.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「...You... Re-Crea, the will of God... will turn me... into an angel... Let's meet again when that happens...」
The body of the Female Demon who might have been Sengen'in-sensei crumbled away completely.

name: Synn
message: 「What she said at the end... what do you think she meant?」
That demon had clearly been speaking to Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「I don't know...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
It wasn't like they knew each other, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn?」
I sensed the presence of a powerful demon close by.
I moved to shield Azel from that presence.

name: Synn
message: 「Who's there!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Bylous.」
The young man radiated arrogance and confidence, as if that name alone should tell us everything we needed to know.
His build was slimmer than Arden's, he lacked Eauderourke's grotesque air, and he was shorter than Melphas.
Yet I was certain beyond a doubt that this young man was indeed Bylous.

name: Bylous
message: 「I had intended to conceal both my magic power and my presence, yet it seems I cannot manage it quite as well as Nive.」

name: Bylous
message: 「It is a pleasure to meet you for the first time, Synn Sakura--and you as well, O legendary Demon Lord.」
Behind me, I sensed Azel catch her breath.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you talking about...?」
I try playing dumb for now. Even though it seems pointless.
Bylous suddenly moved!
The distance of about three meters becomes zero in an instant.
So fast!
Instinctively, I crossed my arms in front of my chest and blocked his fist. Even so, it was a punch so heavy that I was forced to step back slightly.

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh!」

name: Bylous
message: 「You blocked it, huh. Now this is how it should be!」
Bylous was laughing as if he were enjoying himself.
However, I'm in no position to feel the same.
Cold sweat runs down my spine.
I understood from just that brief exchange.
Bylous's power surpasses mine, even though I'm the Demon Lord.
Like this, I won't be able to protect Azel from this guy.
Even so, I--

name: Bylous
message: 「It's truly entertaining, but let's leave it at this for tonight.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「O Demon Lord. You'd best head back and rest early tonight. Having just awakened, your state is unstable, and the backlash will hit you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Backlash...? Urgh...」
Suddenly, all strength drained from my body.
Like water pouring out of a bucket with a hole in it, there's no stopping it.
And then, intense pain floods through my entire body.
The sheer agony robs me of my willpower, and even my transformation begins to undo itself.

name: Bylous
message: 「You overworked parts of yourself you've never used before, so this is only natural.」
I looked like I might collapse at any moment, yet I mustered my willpower and glared at Bylous.
Bylous looked genuinely delighted, to an infuriating degree.

name: Bylous
message: 「I'm looking forward to the day of Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph...」
My whole body feels sluggish, as if mud had been poured into it.
When I turn my eyes toward the presence right beside me, Azel is sitting by my bedside, quietly shedding tears in the cold light of night.
Her tears were crystal clear and beautiful.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Azel. Synn-sama's awake.」
Her wet eyes widened and looked down at me.
My whole body is numb, and I can't move my mouth properly.
On top of that, everything feels terribly sluggish, and if I let my guard down, I'm going to fall right asleep.
Still, I somehow managed to force my voice out.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for making you worry.」
Azel shook her head.
I thought to myself that the old Azel would have said something like, "I wasn't worried at all."

name: Synn
message: 「You're not hurt, right, Azel?」
Azel gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness...」

name: Azel
message: 「Someone like me has no right to be worried over.」

name: Azel
message: 「I... to you...」

name: Azel
message: 「You are...」
After hesitating, Azel opened her mouth again.

name: Azel
message: 「You're... the Demon Lord, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry... for hiding it from you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... you were the one who carried me here too... Azel?」
Azel gave a small shake of her head.

name: Paqy
message: 「It was a Demon.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That Bylous guy from the rumors.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That bastard even saw right through my true identity.」
What is Bylous planning, I wonder?
My head isn't working. I feel so heavy. I'm exhausted.
Suddenly, Azel started to stand up, stumbled, and fell to her knees.
The hands she instinctively thrust out landed on either side of my neck.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay?」
With Azel's face right in front of mine, my heart starts pounding.

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's nothing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't push yourself. Anyone'd end up like that after sitting seiza for about five hours.」

name: Synn
message: 「Five hours...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」
Azel's hands wrapped around both sides of my neck.
Her palms were strangely hot.

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... ngh... aaah.」
The grip of her palms pressing against my neck tightened.

name: Synn
message: 「Gah... A-Azel... what are you...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Azel! Hey, that's... that's no joke, man!」
The force strangling my neck gave way.

name: Synn
message: 「*Cough*, *cough*... huh...?」
Warm droplets fell onto my face.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... why are you crying?」
Her hands pulled away.
I sensed Azel backing away.
